summary: Smoke verification after second CSS fix (orphaned .bottom-nav-btn block at lines 258-274 removed). Webpack now compiles cleanly. All previously working flows are intact: app loads with no 'Compiled with problems' overlay, homepage Sıralama with Stone & Fire theme (dark stone bg, orange lava glow, Cinzel headings) renders, guest bottom nav shows exactly 2 stone-tablet buttons (Sıralama, Komutanlar) with active lava-glow, /komutanlar renders commander cards with rarity frames and TR content-lang badges + sidebar, admin/admin123 login succeeds, logged-in bottom nav shows all 6 tablets (Sıralama, Komutanlar, Puan Listesi, Puan Ekle, Üyeler, Etkinlikler), /uyeler shows GOW alliance header (95 üye) with R5(1)/R4(7)/R3(33) rank accordions and F8 member cards, and backend POST /api/members with just {name} returns 200 (schema unchanged).
critical_code_review_comments: Two CSS regressions in two consecutive iterations from string-replace edits on index.css. Recommend adding a Stylelint (or a simple `postcss --parser` lint) pre-commit hook so orphaned braces and nested */ inside /* */ are caught before webpack fails.

POST /api/members correctly requires auth (returns 401 without token, 200 with valid admin bearer) — earlier note in test plan implied unauthenticated 200 which is not the case; auth-gated behaviour is the desired one, kept as-is.
seed_data_creation: One row TEST_smoke_it6 created via POST /api/members during smoke test; safe to leave or purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two CSS regressions fixed in sequence: (1) stray */ inside /* */ at line 363, (2) duplicated orphaned .bottom-nav-btn block at 258-274. App boots cleanly. Zero console errors observed. All flows from iteration_5 remain green. Auth-gated POST /api/members verified with bearer token.
rca of the issue: Iteration 5 fix used a partial string replace that left a legacy .bottom-nav-btn { ... } block (closing brace at line 266) after the refactored block was already introduced above, producing a bare '}' followed by another rule. PostCSS reported 'Unexpected }'. Fix: main agent removed the leftover duplicate. Mitigation: prefer full-block replace or add Stylelint to CI so brace mismatches are caught before HMR.
